label: The drowned three-seal guardian
description: Combines Underwater and Three-seal boss rules. Channel costs 10 stamina and adds 15 exhaustion after acting. Water pressure adds 5 per turn in this encounter. Recover between channels to keep enough AP, and fill the seal gauge three times. Actual lightning HP damage also charges the seal gauge one-for-one. Tidal shell reflects 25% of lightning damage received. Focus current enables lightning siphon and healing relief. Click the control techniques to try Brine bind, Clear mind, Shake off and Stunning bell.
